root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: two trailing bytes remain after `%` before any hex-digit lookahead may execute
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Inside the `%` branch of `uri_decoder()`, the hex-digit lookahead may only execute when `s + 2 < end` holds. The vulnerable original reaches the lookahead with only the lone `%` byte remaining, while the fixed code rejects that truncated escape before `g_ascii_isxdigit(s[1])` runs.
root_cause_criterion.description: The AddressSanitizer root cause is the missing truncated-escape guard at `uri_decoder()` line 256: before reading `s[1]` or `s[2]`, the decoder must still have two bytes of `%xx` payload available.

nodes.state: Immediately before `g_ascii_isxdigit(s[1])`, the first lookahead address is exactly `end`, so the call reads the byte one past the explicit decoder span.

edges.relation: The one-byte value pointer materialized by `value = attr_end + 1` is forwarded unchanged into `uri_decoder()` as the cursor `s` at the percent-lookahead guard.
The same decoder cursor `s` that lacks two trailing bytes at the guard site is the cursor immediately reused by the `g_ascii_isxdigit(s[1])` sink.
